line: Feel like Drizzy mama thirty years ago the way I carry Drac’
vault_lines: Feel like Drizzy mama thirty years ago the way I carry Drac'
meaning: In this line, Nardo is playing on the name of fellow rapper “Drake”, as it is a homophone for the miniature version of the AK-47, also called a Draco. Many call Draco’s “Dracs”, so Nardo is saying that he carries his Draco like how Drake’s mother used to carry around Drake 30 years ago, when he was a little kid.

line: Don’t drive Suburbans to my show, ayy, throw that ’Cat in gear
vault_lines: Don't drive Suburbans to my show, ayy, throw that 'Cat in gear (Blrrd)
meaning:
The Chevrolet Suburban is a full-size SUV with three rows of seating, a full pickup truck frame, and a V8 engine with American Luxury and popular amongst wealthy celebrities who want an American vehicle luxury experience.



Big30 is talking about instead of driving the American Luxury SUV to his show he would rather drive the “Hellcat” which is a trim from the Dodge Charger and Dodge Challenger lineup which pushes well over 700 horsepower. The Hellcat is a staple in Rap Music.

line: Range SVR, Trackhawk straight and we willin’ to race (Willin’ to race), for real
vault_lines: Range SVR, Trackhawk straight and we willin' to race (Willin' to race), for real
meaning:
Herbo is talking about Land Rover’s: Range Rover Sport luxury performance SUV. The luxury of this vehicle can be compared to Bently and Rolls Royce while keeping a high performance with it’s supercharged 8-cylinder Jaguar engine.



The “Trackhawk” also has a supercharged 8-cylinder which is made from Jeep. While the SUV is not as luxurious as a Bently or Range Rover, it is more performance oriented and outperforms most performance SUV’s.

line: This a super charge, love to make it jerk
vault_lines: This a super charge, love to make it jerk (Vroom, vroom)
meaning: A supercharger is an air compressor that increases the pressure of air supplied to an engine. This results in higher power output (more horsepower) as the engine gets more oxygen in each of its intake cycles and helps it to burn more fuel.
“Opps” means anyone in competition or against you and short for opposition. Wick is saying that his opposition are actors referring to award winning actor Brad Pitt.

Dipping into the music industry by way of rising producer Kaysan — the 27-year-old Los Angeles native who signed with FaZe last summer has already worked with the top artists of the industry like Lil Durk and Future in their hit song “Made A Way”.
